checks.name: boot from gem.d81 on the 1581-mode drive: uOS runs GEMDESK
the 8 key lists the D81, sorted by name
Return launches Calculator through the dispatcher
leaving Calculator reloads GEMDESK, which reopens its window with the selection
Return on a SEQ file opens it in the Editor: the surface matches the Editor oracle
leaving the Editor returns to GEMDESK with the document selected
Return on a UPNT picture opens it in Paint: the banked document and the surface match
